member.name: T:Prowl.PaperUI.TextMask
member.summary:
Masked text, for password fields and anything else that should be readable as shape but not as content.
The mask is a Scribe rather than a second, masked copy of the string: the layout still holds the real text, so cursor positions, selection and hit testing all keep working on what the user actually typed, and nothing is allocated per frame. Line breaks are left alone so a field of several lines keeps its shape.
